Israeli-Style Corn & Pickle Salad

Easy · No cooking required

Ingredients

* 3 cups canned corn, drained very well (about 2 cans)
* 3–4 dill pickles, finely diced
* ½ red bell pepper, finely diced
* ¼ small red onion, finely diced
* 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped

Dressing

* ⅓ cup mayonnaise
* 1 tbsp pickle juice
* 1 tsp Dijon mustard
* ½ tsp garlic powder
* ¼ tsp black pepper
* Pinch of salt
* ½ tsp sugar (optional, but balances the tanginess)

Instructions

* Drain the corn really well so the salad doesn’t become watery.
* Finely dice the pickles, red pepper, and red onion.
* In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise, pickle juice, Dijon, garlic powder, pepper, salt, and sugar.
* Add the dressing to the corn and vegetables.
* Mix everything together and fold in the parsley.
* Refrigerate for at least 30–60 minutes before serving.

My little secrets

* Chop the pickles very small so you get a little pickle in every bite.
* Don’t skip the pickle juice!
* Start with ¼ cup mayo and add more if you want it creamier.
* Make it a few hours ahead of time. It tastes even better once chilled.

My recommendation: Use regular full-fat Hellmann’s mayo and crunchy kosher dill pickles. That combination makes a really good deli-style salad! ❤️
